@Haroenv Dev novel already uses InstantSearch.css: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/chore/remove-css-source/dev/template.html#L16

Docgen needs InstantSearch styles only for the widget showcase, which relies on InstantSearch 2 for now. We need to publish InstantSearch 3 beta and add the styles there afterwards: https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/chore/remove-css-source/docgen/layouts/widget-showcase.pug#L6
